fact: The World Bank project paper of 24 June 2026 says the Zimbabwe Social Registry (ZISO, formerly ISPMIS) is managed by the Ministry, that household data collection was completed in Mangwe in December 2025 and Nkayi in May 2026, and that ZISO is meant to serve programmes across several sectors.
title: Zimbabwe Social Registry Support Project (Project Paper, Report No: PPHI01473)
